description: Route autorisée pour le transport de bois rond dans la Nièvre (58) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.application.i2. Le décret 2003-416 du 30 avril 2003 (en application de l'article 17 de la loi d'orientation forestière du 9 juillet 2001) permet aux préfets de département de fixer par arrêté des itinéraires sur lesquels est autorisé le transport de bois ronds par des véhicules de plus de 4 essieux et dont le poids total roulant ... Coverage: FR. Its keywords include données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
